title: Protein Cookie Dough (No-Bake)
description: Thick, spoonable chocolate chip cookie dough made with whey and 0% Greek yogurt, with about 46g protein per bowl.
instructions: Microwave 15g oat flour in a small bowl for 45–60 seconds, stirring once, until it smells nutty. This removes the raw-flour taste. Let it cool for 1 minute.
In a bowl, stir together 31g whey protein, the 15g toasted oat flour and a pinch of salt until there are no lumps.
Add 1 tsp maple syrup, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract and about 115g of the Greek yogurt. Mash and stir with a fork until a thick dough forms.
Add the remaining 55g Greek yogurt one spoonful at a time until it looks like cookie dough. Adding it all at once makes whey go gummy.
Fold in 10g mini dark chocolate chips, saving a few to press on top.
Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to firm up, or eat right away.
notes: Protein works out to about 12.8g per 100 kcal. For a peanut butter version, add 1 tbsp powdered peanut butter (+25 kcal, +3g protein, <1g fat) instead of real PB, which adds about 8g fat. If using Vega instead of whey, add a splash of milk because it absorbs more liquid. Keeps up to 2 days covered in the fridge.
